title: Craft The Uncraftable Data Pack: 42 New Recipes
description: Stop grinding for hours! Craft 42 previously uncraftable items like the Elytra, Trident, and Bedrock directly in your survival world using logical recipes.
body:
In vanilla Minecraft Java Edition, many powerful and rare items can only be obtained through combat drops, chest loot, or world generation. Once you need an Elytra or a Trident, you either have to grind for hours, rely on random luck, or explore endlessly.

 

I created the Craft The Uncraftable Data Pack to give you total crafting freedom.

 

This data pack brings 42 brand-new crafting recipes directly to your survival world without requiring you to install any mods like Fabric or Forge. You can craft rare drops, End items, and even all music discs using balanced ingredients in a standard crafting table.

 

Core Survival Features

I built this system to feel like it belongs in the base game, using logical and balanced crafting ingredients so it doesn't break your survival experience.

 

1. Rare & Combat Items

 The Feature: Craft powerful items like the Saddle, Elytra, Trident, Name Tag, and Totem of Undying.

The Benefit: You get a new progression path and can obtain essential gear without relying purely on RNG drops or exploring thousands of blocks.

 

2. Special Utility & Terrain Blocks

The Feature: Craft Bedrock, Spawners, End Portal Frames, Sponges, and Heart of the Sea.

The Benefit: You get total control over your builds and mob farms in vanilla survival. You can finally design your base exactly how you want it.

 

3. Complete Music Disc Collection

The Feature: Craft all 15 music discs using a simple Diamond pattern and specific dyes (e.g., Pigstep uses Netherite, Otherside uses Echo Shards).

The Benefit: You can complete your music collection easily without having to trick Skeletons into shooting Creepers!

 

How to Craft Your New Items?

You access all 42 new recipes using standard vanilla mechanics:

Open the Crafting Table: Place down a standard 3x3 Crafting Table.

Shaped Recipes: Place the required items in the exact pattern (like crafting an Elytra with Phantom Membranes and String).

Shapeless Recipes: Place the items anywhere in the grid (like crafting a wet sponge or dragon breath).

 

Installation Requirement

This is a pure Data Pack (no Resource Pack or Mod Loader needed). You MUST place the `.zip` file directly into your world's `datapacks` folder. Once in the game, type `/reload` in the chat to activate all the new recipes. Compatible with Java Edition 1.20.3 and 1.20.4 (pack_format 26).
